contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONST[ANTINV]S PF AVG ; R/ [PRINCIPI IVVENTVTIS]

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), PRINCIPI IVVENVTIS issue of 306-317, Reece period 15. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONST[ANTINV]S PF AVG. Reverse description: Draped figure facing left holding standard in each hand. Reverse inscription: [PRINCIPI IVVENTVTIS]. In exergue: ?PLN for Lyon, ?first officina. Cliff Reeves…
